explanation: The complete generated application surface, authenticated browser relay, queue/detail UI, contextual worker, and deterministic acceptance runner were built. Exact generation, TypeScript compilation, the application boundary, and two-session browser convergence passed. The mandatory MCP wakeup check failed: after successful initialization and subscription, the opaque wakeup generation changed following qualifying reactive work, but no resources-updated notification was emitted across fresh sessions and repeated observer waits. The protocol therefore stopped at a product failure before contextual crash recovery, reconnect/reset, and authorization-termination checks could be completed.
